leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Configure HTTP client timeout settings using the built-in Node.js modules
Implement request cancellation logic with AbortController and AbortSignal
Construct error handling mechanisms for timeout scenarios
Integrate timeout and cancellation features into existing HTTP client code
Manipulate request parameters to include timeout and abort signal options
Apply timeout patterns to both GET and POST HTTP requests
Initialize multiple concurrent requests with individual timeout controls
lessonTitle: Build timeout and cancellation for HTTP clients
